source.title: Roof Repair & Replacement in Oklahoma City | Salazar Roofing
source.description: Searching for a trusted roof repair company in your area? Salazar Roofing offers an extensive range of roof repairs and installation in Oklahoma City. Call us to schedule a roofer!
source.content:
Roofing issues can be intimidating when you don’t know how to navigate the process. We partner with you throughout the project to ensure all your problems are addressed, without selling you stuff you don’t need. We take pride in treating people well and doing roofing the right way.
Mike Salazar | CEO & President
